curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8285-1-1.pdf, 8285-1-2.pdf and 8285-1-6.pdf (books 1/3, 2/3 and 3/3 of the tow truck; the function overview is book 1 pages 2-3, numbered 1-10); 8285-1-3.pdf to 8285-1-5.pdf are the alternate model 8285-2

functions.does: Pushing the truck along turns the V6 engine: the first pair of rear wheels drives a differential, whose bevel gears turn a long shaft forward under the deck; at the front a row of three 16-tooth gears (the middle one idling on the steering shaft) turns the crankshaft, so the six pistons go up and down.
functions.source: book: overview pages 2-3, function 1 (arrows along the truck, the engine photo); book 1 engine sub-steps on pages 52-55 and step 29 (page 56)
functions.note: Only the first rear axle (z 290) has the differential; the second rear axle (z 470) rolls freely. The wheel rims p2332/p2324 sit on the half shafts p72/p73 (59426).

functions.does: The second pair of rear wheels and the front wheels roll freely.
functions.source: inferred: the second rear axle's shafts (p138, p121) carry no gears, and the front wheels sit on the steering stub axles

functions.does: The knob on the cab roof steers the front wheels: its shaft runs down behind the seats, turns through a pair of bevel gears onto a shaft running forward to an 8-tooth pinion on the steering rack, and the rack's ends swing the two steering arms.
functions.source: book: overview pages 2-3, function 2 (the roof knob and a top view of the front wheels steering)

functions.does: The small steering wheel in the cab turns on its own; it isn't linked to the steering.
functions.source: inferred: it sits on an axle pin in the dashboard (p846 43093), apart from the steering column, which runs up to the roof knob

functions.does: The bonnet, with the grille and front wings, tilts forward to show the engine.
functions.source: book: overview page 2, function 1 (photo with the bonnet tilted open over the engine)

functions.does: The knob on top of the sleeper box lowers and raises the two outriggers at the back: a worm on its shaft turns a 24-tooth gear, a long shaft runs back under the deck, and bevel gears turn a cross shaft whose links swing the two black legs down until their feet stand on the ground.
functions.source: book: overview pages 2-3, function 3 (knob, and the photo with arrows at the legs); book 1 steps 5-11 (pages 43-44, worm and 24-tooth gear), book 2 step 53 (page 47, arrows on the knob and a leg)

functions.does: The front knob on the crane base's left side winds the winch: a 12-tooth gear on its shaft turns the 20-tooth gear on the yellow drum, raising or lowering the hook, whose string runs up over the boom tip.
functions.source: book: overview pages 2-3, function 5 (knob and the hook's up-down arrow); book 2 steps 12-15 (pages 53-55, the drum and string), book 6 step 57 (page 11, the hook)
functions.note: The hook block (p1876, p1877) hangs on the string under the boom tip, which is at p1867 42610.

functions.does: A ratchet holds the hook up: the yellow lever over the winch drum carries a pawl, held down by a rubber axle joiner, on the drum's gear; lifting the lever lets the hook be lowered.
functions.source: book: overview pages 2-3, function 4 (a hand lifting the yellow lever beside the winch knob); inferred: what it does, from the parts (lever p1689 32056, cross block p1687, rubber joiner p1692)
functions.skip: only resists gravity; the winch knob works both ways without it

functions.does: The rear knob on the crane base's left side raises and lowers the boom: a worm turns a 24-tooth gear in a hinged bracket, and the gear's two arms push the long black strut up under the boom.
functions.source: book: overview pages 2-3, function 6 (knob and drawing of the boom); book 2 steps 5-11 (pages 49-52, the worm and gear in the swinging bracket), book 6 step 56 (page 10, the strut fitted under the raised boom); inferred: that the strut p1740 is the link from the gear's arms (p1649/p1650 at the axle p1871) to the boom
functions.note: As the boom pivots round its axle, its extension gear rolls round the gear on the pivot axle, so the inner section may creep in or out a little unless the extension knob is held.

functions.does: The knob on the crane base's right side extends and retracts the boom's inner section: bevel gears turn the boom's pivot axle, a shaft up the boom carries the drive to the tip, and an 8-tooth pinion there runs on the racks under the inner section.
functions.source: book: overview pages 2-3, function 7 (arrow along the boom); book 6 steps 10-15 (pages 2-8, the shaft, racks and pinion)

functions.does: Pumping the yellow hand pump on the deck fills the pneumatic system with air.
functions.source: book: overview pages 2-3, function 9; book 6 step 72 (page 41)

functions.does: The valve lever on the crane base's right side sends air to the yellow cylinder under the back of the deck, which raises or lowers the wheel-lift arm.
functions.source: book: overview pages 2-3, functions 8 and 10 (the lever pushed left and right, the wheel lift photographed down and up); book 1 steps 8-10 (the cylinder), book 6 step 59 (page 23)
functions.skip: pneumatic: works by air pressure from the hand pump

functions.does: The wheel-lift arm hinges at the back of the deck, so it swings up and down as the cylinder works it, carrying the grey wheel forks.
functions.source: book: overview pages 2-3, function 10; book 6 steps 9-16 (pages 17-22) and 59 (page 23)

functions.does: The wheel forks hang from the end of the wheel-lift arm on a hinge, sprung by a shock absorber, so they tilt and spring back.
functions.source: book: book 6 steps 9-16 (pages 17-22, the shock absorber between the arm and the fork frame); inferred: that the forks tilt on it
functions.note: The spring's push (p1994 22020-f2) only matters under force.

functions.does: The two side lockers behind the cab open: each door, with a handle, hinges up at its top edge.
functions.source: inferred: each door (p2158 on the right side, p2241 on the left side) hangs on pins along its top edge and has a handlebar handle (p2172, p2255 30031); the book shows no arrows
